files.README.md:
# seaorm-mysql-conversions-mapper

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities and SeaORM 2.0.4 descriptions of the tables, repositories and services, in asynchronous Rust. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mysql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no type for.
- Services: take and return DTOs; updates take a Patch per field: Absent, or set to a value that may be None; errors are `Result<T, DomainError>`.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/database.rs          the connection of DATABASE_URL
src/unit_of_work.rs      the repositories of every table, and the transactions
src/errors.rs            DomainError: NotFound, Conflict, ValidationFailed, Database; no HTTP codes
src/entities/            one entity and one SeaORM description per table
src/repositories/        the repositories of each table
src/services/            one service per table
tests/data/              repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json       what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:app@localhost:3306/app" cargo test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

//! What the service of customers takes and returns.

/// The values of a new Customer. Fields left None take the database's default; the service says which ones are required.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct CustomerCreate {
    pub email: Option<String>,
    pub full_name: Option<String>,
    pub status: Option<String>,
    pub created_at: Option<chrono::NaiveDateTime>,
    pub balance_cents: Option<i32>,
    pub nickname: Option<String>,
    pub country: Option<String>,
}

/// A Customer as services return it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct CustomerRead {
    pub id: i32,
    pub email: String,
    pub full_name: String,
    pub status: String,
    pub created_at: chrono::NaiveDateTime,
    pub balance_cents: i32,
    pub nickname: Option<String>,
    pub country: String,
}

/// The values of a Customer that change: fields left Absent keep their value; Patch::Set(None) empties one.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct CustomerUpdate {
    pub email: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
    pub full_name: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
    pub status: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
    pub created_at: crate::common::Patch<Option<chrono::NaiveDateTime>>,
    pub balance_cents: crate::common::Patch<Option<i32>>,
    pub nickname: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
    pub country: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
}
